item.tib: tshad ma kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa
item.skt: pra mA Na sa muts+tsha ya nA ma pra ka ra Na
item.coloph: slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po su d+ha rak+Shi ta dang bod kyi lo tsA ba dge bsnyen seng rgyal gyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o/ 'jam pa'i mgon pos bkas bskul phyogs kyi glang po'i bstan bcos rgya mtsho ltar zab 'di/ rigs ldan rgyal po'i bka' bskul bor bzangs srung mdzad ces bya sde bdun bshad mkhan dang / gzus chung ston pa'i bkas bskul dge bsnyen sengrgyal zhes bya zha ma lo ts+tshas bsgyur/ dge gang bsod nams bkas skul 'gro kun rigs lam la gnas byang chub myur thob shog

item.colophTitle: tshad ma kun las btus pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa

translator.name: rgya gar gyi mkhan po su d+ha na rak+Shi ta
bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba dge bsnyen seng rgyal
slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po

item.tib: tshad ma kun las btus pa
item.skt: pra mA Na sa muts+tsha ya
item.coloph: tshad ma kun las btus pa rtsod pa chen po shin du phra ba'i thugs mnga' ba/ slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi phas kyi rgol ba rnams/ 'joms par byed la glang po'i stobs ldan pa/ phyogs kyi glang po'i gzhung kun las btus pa/ bdag nyid kyi ni 'byor pa la brten nas/ shis pa'i dge gnas gtsug lag khang gnas su/ rgya gar mkhan po gser gyi go cha dang / sgra bsgyur lo tsA dad pa'i shes rab kyis/ bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa yin
